text:
Lena: Hey design ops — quick ask for the PLG launch next week. Need a 'mini flight' visual pack: hero banner (1200x628, PNG + SVG), 3 microcards for benchmark callouts (600x600, 1:1), 2 social story frames (1080x1920), and a compact one-pager diagram of 'inference economics' that fits an 8.5x11 print. Low-lift variants only, 48h turnaround if possible.
Raj: ack — are there finalized headlines/copy?
Lena: pasted copy below. Priority order: hero > microcards > diagram > stories. Use primary CTA: "Try Redwood Inference". Tone: punchy, engineer-friendly.
Lena: Copy block:
"Reduce per-token cost without losing answers. Switch to Redwood runtimes for predictable latency and up to 3x throughput on select workloads."
Maya: @Lena sending brand checklist — confirm which color tokens to use and whether to use the updated logo mark (v2). Also need accessible contrast checks for text on hero.
Lena: use brand tokens: redwood-primary, slate-600, plus neutral-100 bg. Logo v2 ok. We must pass AA for body and AAA for large headings.
Tom: Can you drop the Figma file link? I'll slot this into the sprint board and assign resources.
Lena: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/miniflight-visuals — permissions open to marketing+design
BrandBot: Brand compliance scan initiated: found 1 potential issue — hero copy uses "3x throughput" which triggers comparative claim flag. Please confirm substantiation or rephrase.
Sam: Legal here. For comparative claims please add substantiation source or change to "up to 3x" or "measured on selected workloads". Prefer the latter.
Lena: ok switching to "up to 3x throughput on select workloads". Will update copy in figma.
Raj: timeline check — 48h still doable after copy tweak?
Tom: design team can do hero + microcards in 24h, diagram may take 36h. Stories dependent on final assets. I'll prioritize.
Maya: Quick UX note — microcards should include token/latency sparklines (very small) and a short footnote: "test workload: 512 tokens, offline benchmark".
Lena: noted. Also need exports: PNG @2x, SVG for web, and a white-background printable PDF for the one-pager.
Tom: tagging @Dylan (animations) for potential micro-anim GIFs if we have extra cycle.
Dylan: I can do 2 micro-card GIF variants if design hands off static frames by EOD.
Lena: thanks all. Will update figma copy and add a redline doc for the diagram data points. Ping here when assets are ready.
Raj: :thumbsup:
Maya: I'll run final brand pass once frames are exported and send sign-off sticker.
BrandBot: Compliance scan complete: after copy change no active flags remain. Recommend including substantiation doc in asset package.
Sam: perfect — once substantiation doc is attached, legal signs off.
Lena: prepping substantiation PDF and will upload to figma attachments. Closing loop in 6h. Thanks folks! :rocket:
